trap.label: give a talk
trap.wrong: She made a talk on etiquette.
trap.right: She gave a talk on etiquette.
trap.why: Em português “fazer uma palestra”. Em inglês, a colocação é give a talk/speech.

fix.wrong: He made way to the car.
fix.right: He gave way to the car.

rewrite.prompt: Use give a talk: “She did a talk on manners.”
rewrite.answer: She gave a talk on manners.

rewrite.prompt: Use give way: “He yielded to the car.”
rewrite.answer: He gave way to the car.
